user.title: YouVersion Bible API
user.description: Enter your YouVersion Platform App Key. Create a free developer account and register an application at https://developers.youversion.com to get one, then pick the language you want Bible versions listed in.

select.title: Bible version
select.description: Choose the Bible version used for the Verse of the Day. The list shows the versions enabled for your App Key in the selected language.

error.invalid_version: The selected Bible version is not valid.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the YouVersion API.
error.no_versions: No Bible versions were returned for this App Key and language. Try a different language code.

init.description: Change the Bible version or language used for the Verse of the Day.
